Select2 4.0.13 (minified)
=========================
Source: https://github.com/select2/select2
Files:  dist/js/select2.full.min.js, dist/css/select2.min.css (MIT)
Pinned:  matches plugin handles sto-select2-vendor in includes/Assets.php

Required for Theme Settings Select, Typography, Dynamic Object, and Code Editor
language controls. Without these files, admin selects stay native OS dropdowns.
